entities.summary: Nysier Ta-Jhon Brooks is an American professional basketball player for Çayırova Belediye of the Türkiye Basketbol Ligi (TBL). He played college basketball for the Cincinnati Bearcats, the Miami Hurricanes, and the Ole Miss Rebels.
